summary_en: Maeda Kosen announced execution of block purchase of 1,366,700 shares (2.05% of outstanding shares) at 2,195 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 16, 2026, as part of a larger 15 million share authorization with 3 billion yen budget approved by board the same day.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Maeda Kosen announced on November 13, 2026, that it will execute a block purchase of 1,366,700 shares of its common stock at a fixed price of 2,195 yen per share via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on November 16, 2026. This block execution represents 2.05% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The purchase constitutes part of a broader authorization approved by the board of directors on the same date, which allows the company to acquire up to 15 million shares with a budget ceiling of 3 billion yen through November 30, 2026, using the same ToSTNeT-3 method. The purchase will be executed at the closing price (including final special quotation) of 2,195 yen. The company noted that the lead shareholder and representative director Naohiro Maeda has indicated intention to sell a portion of his shareholdings, and depending on the execution results, there may be a change in the company's lead shareholder. Results will be announced after the 8:45 a.m. trading window closes.
